title: Skeptic Strategy Spec (IR) v7
description: v7 (F2/F3) adds the UW flow/sentiment/pin indicators (net_premium, market_tide, nope as sign+rank pairs; put_call_flow_ratio and max_pain_distance_pct as unit-free raw comparisons). v6 (F1) adds the UW dealer-positioning indicators gex_level, gex_rank_1y, dex_level and dex_rank_1y. v5 (F4) adds the IVS-derived vol-surface indicators skew_25d and term_structure_slope. v4 adds backtest.resolution (FX.1: per-session bar resolution at the intraday clock) and entry.intraday_scan (FX.2: continuous opportunity scanning); parser vocabulary lands at FX.5 - the parser gate lives in parse.py, not in this IR contract. v3 (D5a) adds the scale-in ladder primitive (entry.scale_in) and a general intraday session force-flat (exit.close_at_time). v2 (D1c) adds greek-based exits (delta_stop_abs, theta_harvest), position.max_vega_per_contract, and the IVX/HV indicators. v1/v2 specs remain valid; v2 vocabulary requires spec_version 2, v3 vocabulary requires spec_version 3, v4 vocabulary requires spec_version 4, v5 vocabulary requires spec_version 5, v6 vocabulary requires spec_version 6, and v7 vocabulary requires spec_version 7 (validation enforces).

description_raw.description: The user's original natural-language description, verbatim.

method.description: delta: nearest |delta|; offset_pct: strike = spot*(1+value); atm: accepted on input, normalized to delta 0.5 during validation (ATM IS the 50-delta strike); width_from_leg: strike = referenced leg strike +/- value dollars (spreads/condors), value must be > 0, filled width may deviate from value by at most value (else the entry skips as wing_width_unavailable).

expiration_selection.description: At clock=daily these are CALENDAR days (v1 semantics, unchanged). At clock=5min they are TRADING days (Friday '1DTE' selects Monday's expiry). 0 = same-day expiry (0DTE) and requires spec_version 2.

max_vega_per_contract.description: spec_version 2. Entry-time cap on |NET vega| of the contract-set in DOLLARS per contract-set per vol point: leg vegas sum SIGNED (long +, short -, x ratio), then abs, x 100. A spread's cancelling legs net; entries above the cap skip (vega_cap_exceeded); missing vega data skips (vega_unavailable) - the rule is never silently ignored.

time_of_day.description: spec_version 2; requires backtest.clock=5min. Earliest ET bar an entry may fill (e.g. "10:00" = no entries before the 10:00 bar). Sub-5-minute precision does not exist in the record - the parser must ask rather than round.

indicator.description: All computed on strictly trailing windows over the underlying (or VIX). ema_cross_state compares fast vs slow EMA: value encodes {fast, slow}, operator above/below. spec_version 2 adds the vendor IVX/HV family (2005+ on all tickers): ivx_rank_1y = percentile rank (0-100) of the 30d IV Mean within the trailing 252 observations, unevaluable (False) below 126 trailing observations; ivx_level_30d = the 30d IV Mean in percentage points (like vix_level: 'IVX above 25' -> value 25); hv_iv_spread_30d = (30d IV Mean - 30d HV) in percentage points. spec_version 5 adds the IVS-derived vol-surface signals (2007+, derived nightly from the fitted surface; both in VOL POINTS): skew_25d = IV(25-delta put) - IV(25-delta call) at the 30d tenor, linearly interpolated in delta (positive = puts rich); term_structure_slope = ATM IV(90d) - ATM IV(30d) from each tenor's exact ATM row (negative = inverted). Both are EOD fits: at intraday bars they read the PREVIOUS session's surface. Sessions lacking the tenor or bracketing deltas are unavailable (False), never interpolated across tenors. spec_version 6 adds the UW dealer-positioning family (2025-07-08+, VENDOR UNITS meaningful in sign and rank only): gex_level = net dealer gamma (call_gamma + put_gamma; positive = dealers long gamma, threshold 0 is the only honest raw comparison); dex_level = net dealer delta likewise; gex_rank_1y / dex_rank_1y = percentile rank (0-100) of the current value within the trailing 252 observations, unevaluable (False) below 126 trailing observations (the ivx_rank floor). These are EOD observations: at intraday bars they read the PREVIOUS session. Runs conditioned on this family REFUSE pre-run when the backtest window starts before the signal's first covered session — corrupted long-window stats are prevented, not disclosed. spec_version 7 adds the UW flow/sentiment/pin EOD reductions (2026-02-24+, same refusal + rank-floor semantics): net_premium_level = session net call minus put premium (vendor dollars — sign/rank only); market_tide_level = the MARKET-WIDE cumulative tide's session total (one series for all tickers; sign/rank only); nope_level = the vendor's NOPE at the last session stamp (dimensionless but vendor-implemented — sign/rank only); put_call_flow_ratio = session put/call volume (unit-free ratio, raw thresholds legal, 'above 1' = 1); max_pain_distance_pct = (front-expiry max pain − close)/close × 100 (unit-free %, raw thresholds legal, signed). All EOD: previous session at intraday bars.

timeframe.description: spec_version 2 when 5min. Which bar series the indicator reads. 5min requires backtest.clock=5min and is valid only for price-series indicators (rsi/sma/ema/price_vs_*/ema_cross_state/price_vs_vwap_pct). price_vs_vwap_pct is intraday-ONLY: percent distance of the current 5-min last from the session-anchored VWAP (last x volume over the session's bars; the record carries no intra-bar H/L - disclosed approximation). Warmup bars evaluate False.

scale_in.description: spec_version 3. The scale-in ladder primitive (D5a): legs accumulate into ONE basket with a blended cost basis; exits act on the whole basket. Valid ONLY on single-leg structures (long_call/long_put) in D5a - a multi-leg ladder is refused with a 'not yet' message. sizing.method must be fixed_contracts (rungs specify absolute contract counts). A scale-in run is hard-capped at insufficient_evidence (reason 'scale-in safety checks pending (D5c)') until the martingale defenses land in D5c - the interlock keeps an undefended martingale from ever being blessed.

mode.description: Only mode this phase; leaves room for future scale-in modes.

basket.description: Legs accumulate into one blended-cost-basis position; the whole basket exits together.

rungs.description: Ordered ladder rungs. Each rung is an entry condition (same vocabulary as entry.conditions) plus add_contracts; each fires AT MOST ONCE per basket. The first rung opens the basket; when a bar satisfies several rungs at once (a gap through thresholds) they all fire at that bar's ask. Adds that would breach max_total_contracts are clamped to the remaining capacity (flagged cap_clamped) and no deeper rung fires.

add_contracts.description: Absolute contract count added when this rung fires (not a percent of capital).

rearm.description: After a basket closes, a fresh basket may open only once this condition passes (the signal leaves the oversold zone, e.g. RSI back above 30). Prevents an infinite add loop. Same condition vocabulary as a rung.

stop_adding_on.description: How the ladder stops deepening. Default next_rung_not_reached: a rung simply never fires if its threshold is not reached (no extra detector). reversal_signal (a rung stops even if later reached, once a reversal condition triggers) is reserved for a later phase - the field is forward-compatible but only next_rung_not_reached is implemented in D5a.

max_total_contracts.description: Hard cap on total basket contracts across all rungs - the ruin guardrail. Required whenever scale_in is present; must be >= the largest single rung's add_contracts.

intraday_scan.description: spec_version 4; requires clock 5min. Continuous opportunity scanning (FX.2). Absent and once_per_session are identical (the first fill ends the session's entries - bit-identical D2 behavior). every_setup: one entry per SIGNAL EPISODE (conditions transitioning false->true arm exactly one entry - a persistent signal is one setup, never a burst), re-entry after intraday exits, and condition-less strategies re-arm when a position closes (the position lifecycle is the episode). On minute grids a signal at a quote-less bar ARMS an order that fills at the NEXT quoted bar's real NBBO even if the signal faded (one-quoted-bar validity; liquidity gates still apply; the episode is consumed fill-or-skip; both bars disclosed in the trade detail). Bounded by max_concurrent_positions and capital; every skip is counted with a reason. Mutually exclusive with entry.scale_in.

exit.description: At least one of profit_target_pct, stop_loss_pct, time_exit_dte, conditions, delta_stop_abs, theta_harvest, or close_at_time must be present; the parser must ASK rather than default when the user gave none. Exit priority in the engine: stop_loss -> delta_stop -> profit_target -> theta_harvest -> time_exit -> condition exits; close_at_time is a separate end-of-session force-flat evaluated per 5-minute bar (it overrides everything at/after its time).

profit_target_pct.description: Percent of max credit captured (credit) or premium gain (debit).

stop_loss_pct.description: Percent of credit received (credit) or premium paid (debit) lost.

delta_stop_abs.description: spec_version 2. Close the position when any watched leg's |delta| reaches this threshold at the daily marks (short legs when the position has any, else all legs). Decimal in (0,1); whole-number deltas (30) are normalized to decimals (0.30) at validation. Days where the watched legs carry no delta are unevaluable - the rule waits, it never guesses.

theta_harvest.description: spec_version 2. DTE-band profit harvest: inside the window [dte_to, dte_from] (DTE counts down), close as soon as profit >= profit_pct of max. Valid ONLY on structures with a defined max profit (short_put, put_credit_spread, call_credit_spread, iron_condor, covered_call) - validation refuses it on long_call/long_put and the parser must ASK instead. dte_from must be > dte_to (enforced by validation).

close_at_time.description: spec_version 3; requires backtest.clock=5min. Force-flat every open position at the first 5-minute bar at or after this ET time - the 'no overnight' rule, symmetric with entry.schedule.time_of_day. No new entries or ladder adds fire at or after it. Meaningless on the daily clock (validation refuses); a malformed time is a validation error, never silently ignored.

slippage_half_spread_fraction.description: Fraction of the half-spread conceded from mid toward the adverse quote. 0 (mid fills) is forbidden by validation; 1.0 = full adverse quote. When a quote's open interest is known and thin, the effective fraction scales up to 1.0: slip_eff = slip + (1 - slip) * max(0, 1 - oi / (10 * min_open_interest)); unknown liquidity is never penalized, only disclosed.

max_spread_pct.description: Entry liquidity gate: quotes whose spread (ask - bid) exceeds this percent of mid are not filled at entry (skip with reason illiquid_spread, or full-adverse fill in stress mode). Exits are never gated - a position can always pay the quoted price to close.

min_open_interest.description: Entry liquidity floor: known open interest below this skips the entry (illiquid_oi). 0 disables. Missing OI is never gated, only disclosed in the run's liquidity profile.

min_volume.description: Entry liquidity floor on session volume (illiquid_volume). 0 (default) disables. Missing volume is never gated, only disclosed.

liquidity_mode.description: skip: gated contracts are never filled (reasoned skip). stress: gated contracts fill at the full adverse quote (slip 1.0) - the strategy keeps running but pays worst quoted prices.

clock.description: spec_version 2 when not daily. The engine's declared decision cadence. daily: decisions at each session close (original engine, bit-identical). 5min: decisions at each 5-minute bar; entries fill at the DECISION bar's quote and exits evaluate starting the NEXT bar (a stop can never fire on its entry bar); fills come from REAL intraday NBBO only (iVolatility 5-min, CBOE minute forward) - no synthetic quotes, a gap is a gap; intraday coverage is a short-DTE slice (0-2 trading-DTE, ATM+/-$8) and specs needing more are refused before running; equity is marked once per session close at every clock. Exit priority is identical at every clock: stop_loss -> delta_stop -> profit_target -> theta_harvest -> time_exit -> condition exits.

resolution.description: spec_version 4; requires clock 5min. Per-session bar-resolution policy (FX.1). Absent and explicit 5min are identical (bit-identical runs). finest selects the finest HONEST grid PER SESSION from the collector-built resolution map: the minute grid where minute data is banked for that session, else 5-min. Fills quote from real 5-min NBBO stamps at every resolution - minute bars between stamps carry no chain and can fill nothing; timeframe-5min indicators sample only the 5-min underlying stamps on minute grids (resolution never changes signal meaning); the per-session mix is recorded on the run (resolution_mix + compressed resolution_runs) and a re-run that changed because minute data newly arrived is a RESOLUTION UPGRADE, never a silent shift.
